title: JD.com Super Brain 3.0 Large Model Makes Its Debut, Creating an AI Commander for the Entire Logistics Process
excerpt: Large model technology is accelerating from "paper concepts" to "practical operations" in industrial applications. At the 18th International Transportation Tech
content_html:
Large model technology is accelerating from "paper concepts" to "practical operations" in industrial applications. At the 18th International Transportation Technology and Equipment Exhibition held recently, JD.com officially launched its latest "Super Brain" large model version 3.0. As the first industrial-level application integration in the logistics industry that realizes full-process AI command, this version has achieved key breakthroughs in core technologies and supply chain collaboration.

In terms of core technologies and operational efficiency, "Super Brain" 3.0 demonstrates powerful computing capabilities. Facing a massive and complex volume of hundreds of millions of packages, the model can achieve a qualitative leap in end-to-end route planning, calculating the optimal solution in just a few seconds. This extremely high response speed breaks through the efficiency bottleneck of traditional logistics in multi-dimensional variable calculations.

In terms of business coverage, "Super Brain" 3.0 has truly integrated the entire supply chain. It can seamlessly cover all core links, including warehouse entry, transfer sorting, trunk transportation, and last-mile delivery. By intelligently coordinating and optimizing key elements of the supply chain, the system not only significantly improves overall operational efficiency but also effectively controls operational costs.

As the latest achievement of the deep integration of AI technology with the physical industry, the launch of "Super Brain" 3.0 not only marks a new stage in smart logistics, but also provides an industry model that is feasible and replicable for the intelligent transformation of the entire logistics industry.
